items.headline: Citibank commodities chief joins Gen10 CTRM board
items.summary: Gen10, vendor of the agentic CommOS CTRM platform, added Citibank's Global Head of Commodities, Jose Cogolludo, to its advisory board, per the company's announcement.

items.headline: Trafigura closes upsized $4.4bn syndicated loan
items.summary: Trafigura closed an upsized US$4.4bn syndicated loan facility, reinforcing continued bank appetite for large revolving credit lines to major commodity trading houses, per GTR.

items.headline: Record tanker rates push Asia away from US crude
items.summary: Reuters reports tanker freight rates hit record highs, making US crude uneconomic for Asian refiners who are shifting purchases to Middle East and Latin American grades instead.

items.headline: ACER reporting guidance deadline nears under recast REMIT
items.summary: Under the recast REMIT Implementing Regulation, ACER must issue electronic formats and guidance for exposure and transaction reporting (Articles 3, 4 and 6) by 29 October 2026, affecting energy market participants' reporting builds.
